name: norway-exports-daily
title: Norwegian gas landings, daily, Oct 2026
description: Daily physical flows at the points where Norwegian gas lands, 1 to 28 Oct 2026, from the ENTSOG Transparency Platform: the continental points of the hourly norway-exports dataset plus Easington (Langeled), which National Gas reports per gas day only. Each reading is the gas day's flow, shown at the start of the gas day (06:00 CET). St Fergus mixes Norwegian and UK gas (its flow is above what Vesterled can carry), so Vesterled, FLAGS and SAGE have no readings. Emden EPT1 is Europipe I and Norpipe together, read on the Emden terminal.
